snippet.title: Weed Shop The Game for iOS & Android
snippet.description:
Run your very own Medical Marijuana Dispensary aka Weed Shop in sunny California! 
Grow the hottest strains like the Chronic, Purple Haze, White Widow and many more. Make mad money selling weed to local stoners, pimp out your shop or even smoke what you grow! 
Visit http://www.weedshopgame.com for more info!

Download Weed Shop The Game!
iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/weed-shop-the-game/id985139469?mt=8
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adhdstudios.weedshop (Banned by Google)

Get Weed Bakery The Game!
iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/weed-bakery/id972529663?mt=8
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adhdstudios.weedshop2 (Banned by Google)

Try Weed Garden The Game:!
iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/weed-garden-online/id968596273?mt=8
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adhdstudios.weedshop3 (Banned by Google)
